title: when you cannot sleep

verses.text: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.

caption:
For the nights when your body is tired but your mind will not stay quiet.

Sleep is not something we manage into place. It is something we are given. Scripture keeps saying the same steady thing over the dark hours: you can lie down, because the One who never sleeps is holding what you cannot.

Psalm 4:8, Psalm 3:5, Proverbs 3:24 (BSB)

Save this for the next night rest will not come.
Send it to someone who has been lying awake this week.
